flags.reason: This module is imported unconditionally by finetune.utils and Trainer but is absent, so the documented training entry point fails at import time.
The Stage-2 launcher requests model_name dove-s2, but the repository registers only dove-s1, so get_model_cls necessarily rejects this command.
The core inference program invoked by README.md and inference.sh is absent, so none of the supplied testing commands can run.
The quantitative metric program invoked throughout README.md and inference.sh is absent, preventing reproduction of the reported evaluation.
The released Stage-1 recipe trains for 10,000 steps on datasets/test/UDM10/GT-Video, directly contaminating the named test benchmark.
Whenever validation references are configured, the dataset overwrites the first training examples with those validation GT videos, explicitly leaking validation targets into training.
Paired HQ and LQ crops draw independent temporal start indices, so corresponding training clips usually depict different frames despite the function promising alignment.
RandomVideoCompression cyclically shifts every decoded sequence by one frame, destroying temporal alignment with the HQ target for no documented reason.
The dataset length is the video count but images are not repeated when shorter; with the documented 2,055 HQ-VSR videos and 800 DIV2K images, indexing fails past image 799.
Stage-2 returns hq_image/lq_image samples, but the only trainer collate/loss path discards these keys and uses only videos, so DIV2K and image_ratio cannot affect training.
Stage-2 enables DISTS and frame-difference losses, but the sole compute_loss implementation uses only latent MSE and never reads either configured loss weight.
SPMCS, YouHQ40, RealVSR, and MVSR4x predictions are all evaluated against UDM10/GT instead of their matching ground truth, invalidating or crashing those evaluations.
Each result name is assigned dover_results[i-1], cyclically shifting scores so every per-sample DOVER score is attached to the wrong video.
The SFT wrapper computes (alpha*x-v)/sigma; the later get_velocity conversion then returns v itself, which validation decodes as if it were a clean latent.

The empty-prompt asset is documented and bundled under pretrained_models/prompt_embeddings, but training only searches data_root/cache/prompt_embeddings and otherwise encodes text inside DataLoader workers.
The documented final checkpoint conversion uses checkpoint/DOVE-/checkpoint-500 rather than the Stage-2 output checkpoint/DOVE-s2, so the command targets a nonexistent directory.
Validation unconditionally dereferences ref_video.shape before checking whether a reference exists, although validation_ref_videos is optional in the argument schema.
Stage-2 sets two frames while its own comment requires frame counts of 8N+1, and the corresponding schema validity check is commented out.
The install manifest omits deepspeed even though the bundled accelerate configuration always selects DEEPSPEED, and also omits imported packages such as diffusers, pyiqa, safetensors, and PyYAML.
The auxiliary evaluation scripts chdir/import bundled VBench, DOVER, and scripts/RAFT trees that are absent, so the provided VBench/DOVER/Ewarp evaluators are not self-contained.
